ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Advice delivery, Analysis and later stages need Fact find complete and Paraplanner.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(CASE(Stage__c, "Fact find", 1, "Analysis", 2, "Report drafted", 3, "Report issued", 4, "Accepted", 5, "Completed", 6, 0) >= 2, OR(NOT(Fact_find_complete__c), ISBLANK(Paraplanner__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Fact find complete and Paraplanner before moving to Analysis.
